about_the_game:
Maximize your WWE 2K25 experience! The WWE 2K25 Ringside Pass includes all Season Pass content (5 post-launch DLC Character Packs and the SuperCharger), plus the Superstar Mega-Boost to give you the ultimate edge in WWE 2K25.

Full DLC Character Pack details will be revealed at a later date. The Ringside Pass is also included as part of WWE 2K25 The Bloodline Edition.
